Hasan Piker's Comments on US Foreign Policy and Iran's Nuclear Program

Online personality Hasan Piker stated in an Axios interview that the United States has conducted "tremendous terror," which he described as worse than al-Qaeda. Piker also suggested that the Middle East would be more stable if Iran possessed nuclear weapons. These remarks were reported by The Jerusalem Post and Fox News.
